sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi, and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《纽约时报》，我是萨布丽娜·塔韦尔尼西，欢迎收听《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: In the weeks since Israel suffered the deadliest day in its history,
sentences.zh: 在以色列遭遇其历史上死伤最惨重的一天之后的数周里，

sentences.en: fresh accounts have emerged in village after village of just how extreme and how widespread the violence actually was.
sentences.zh: 一个又一个村庄不断传出新的叙述，讲述着那场暴力究竟是多么极端、多么普遍。

sentences.en: Today, the story of one man at the epicenter of that violence.
sentences.zh: 今天，我们将讲述身处那场暴力风暴中心的一个男人的故事。

sentences.en: It's Friday, October 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月13日，星期五。

sentences.en: Hello?
sentences.zh: 喂？

sentences.en: Hi, Golan.
sentences.zh: 嗨，戈兰。

sentences.en: This is Sabrina Tavernisi from The Daily, from The New York Times Daily PodcaSt.
sentences.zh: 我是《每日新闻》的萨布丽娜·塔韦尔尼西，来自《纽约时报》每日播客。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Hi.
sentences.zh: 嗨。

sentences.en: Thank you for talking to us.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: Yeah, of course.
sentences.zh: 好的，当然。

sentences.en: I'm on my way to the, I think it's the most quiet place I can find.
sentences.zh: 我正在去一个地方的路上，我想那是我能找到的最安静的地方了。

sentences.en: Great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: Perfect.
sentences.zh: 完美。

sentences.en: Golan, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 戈兰，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: I know you must be absolutely exhausted.
sentences.zh: 我知道你一定筋疲力尽了。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's not easy.
sentences.zh: 是的，这不容易。

sentences.en: Where are you right now?
sentences.zh: 你现在在哪里？

sentences.en: We are, all the community were evacuated to an hotel in the Dead Sea.
sentences.zh: 我们是，整个社区都被疏散到了死海的一家酒店。

sentences.en: All the refugees, we all got to this place.
sentences.zh: 所有的难民，我们都来到了这个地方。

sentences.en: This is practically, I think, 90% of the hotel is people from my kibbutz.
sentences.zh: 这里实际上，我认为有90%的酒店住客都是我所在的基布兹的人。

sentences.en: Golan, can you identify yourself for me, please?
sentences.zh: 戈兰，请你自我介绍一下好吗？

sentences.en: Tell me your name, your age, and where you live.
sentences.zh: 告诉我你的名字、年龄以及你住在哪里。

sentences.en: My name is Golan, my age is 44, I live in Kibbutz Berry, and I was born in the kibbutz.
sentences.zh: 我叫戈兰，今年44岁，我住在贝里基布兹，我就是在这个基布兹出生的。

sentences.en: The kibbutz.
sentences.zh: 这个基布兹。

sentences.en: The kibbutz was established in 46.
sentences.zh: 这个基布兹建于1946年。

sentences.en: It's older than the state of Israel, and it's a quiet place, surrounded by nature.
sentences.zh: 它比以色列国还要古老，是个被大自然环绕的安静地方。

sentences.en: And I've been living there all my life with my family.
sentences.zh: 我一生都在那里和我的家人一起生活。

sentences.en: How many people in the kibbutz?
sentences.zh: 基布兹里有多少人？

sentences.en: We have, like, 2,000 people in the kibbutz.
sentences.zh: 我们基布兹大约有2000人。

sentences.en: And we know each one of them by name because we lived with them since I was born, and we know the name of the kids.
sentences.zh: 我们认识这里的每一个人，因为从我出生起我们就和他们生活在一起，我们认识这里的孩子们。

sentences.en: We know everybody.
sentences.zh: 我们认识所有人。

sentences.en: We all vouch for each other.
sentences.zh: 我们都互相担保。

sentences.en: We all take care of each other.
sentences.zh: 我们都互相照顾。

sentences.en: And it's an amazing place to raise your kids in.
sentences.zh: 这是一个抚养孩子的好地方。

sentences.en: Do you have children?
sentences.zh: 你有孩子吗？

sentences.en: I have four kids.
sentences.zh: 我有四个孩子。

sentences.en: The older one is 15, his sister is 14, and my twin girls are nine.
sentences.zh: 老大15岁，他妹妹14岁，我的一对双胞胎女儿9岁。

sentences.en: Oh, twin girls.
sentences.zh: 哦，双胞胎女儿。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And the kids are going freely.
sentences.zh: 孩子们可以自由活动。

sentences.en: They don't have any traffic inside the kibbutz.
sentences.zh: 基布兹里面没有任何车辆交通。

sentences.en: Just go send the kids to the grandparents on the other side of the kibbutz, and they can go, and you don't worry because nothing bad can happen.
sentences.zh: 只要把孩子送到基布兹另一头的祖父母那里去，他们自己就能走过去，你不用担心，因为不会发生什么坏事。

sentences.en: Golan, I'm going to turn us now to the attack, but first I want you to tell me about Friday.
sentences.zh: 戈兰，我接下来想把话题转向袭击，但首先我想请你讲讲星期五的事。

sentences.en: How did you spend the day before the attack began?
sentences.zh: 袭击开始前的那一天你是怎么度过的？

sentences.en: What was Friday like for you?
sentences.zh: 对你来说，星期五是怎样的一天？

sentences.en: On Friday morning, 5 in the morning, I got up in Reykjavik, Iceland.
sentences.zh: 星期五早上，早上5点，我在冰岛雷克雅未克醒来。

sentences.en: Oh, my goodness.
sentences.zh: 哦，天哪。

sentences.en: I woke up in Reykjavik, Iceland, coming back from work and landed in Israel in about 6 in the evening, and two hours later I was at home.
sentences.zh: 我在冰岛雷克雅未克醒来，刚下班回来，大约晚上6点降落在以色列，两小时后我就到家了。

sentences.en: So this was my Friday, and I saw my kids after a week.
sentences.zh: 这就是我的星期五，我一周后见到了我的孩子们。

sentences.en: I didn't see them, I spent time with them, we ate dinner together, I saw my friends, we had some drinks, and went to sleep like a normal Friday.
sentences.zh: 我没有错过他们，我和他们呆在一起，我们一起吃晚饭喝了点酒，像个平常的星期五一样去睡觉了。

sentences.en: And then we woke up in about 6.20 in the morning to the sound of launching missiles.
sentences.zh: 然后我们在早上6点20分左右被发射导弹的声音惊醒。

sentences.en: It was a huge, huge launch.
sentences.zh: 那是一次非常非常大规模的发射。

sentences.en: And I remember telling my wife, what is going on?
sentences.zh: 我记得我当时对妻子说，这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: What is, it's out of the blue.
sentences.zh: 这到底是什么，太突如其来了。

sentences.en: We are on the border of Gaza, we know what it's like to have a missile attack, we are used to it,
sentences.zh: 我们位于加沙边境，我们知道遭受导弹袭击是什么样的，我们已经习惯了，

sentences.en: but this time it was weird, it was suddenly, and it was so intensive.
sentences.zh: 但这一次很诡异，太突然了，而且非常密集。

sentences.en: And a few minutes later, we got a text message, we have an app of the community, so we got a text that there is an invasion to the kibbutz,
sentences.zh: 几分钟后，我们收到了一条短信，我们有一个社区的应用程序，所以我们收到了一条短信说基布兹遭到了入侵，

sentences.en: and that we should lock ourselves in the shelter.
sentences.zh: 让我们把自己反锁在避难室里。

sentences.en: In the second I got this message, I went to my safe and took my gun, it's a pistol, it's a small 9mm pistol, and it's what I have for personal defense.
sentences.zh: 就在我收到这条消息的一瞬间，我去保险箱拿了我的枪，那是一把手枪，一把小的9毫米手枪，这是我用来防身的东西。

sentences.en: So the first thing that felt right to do for me is to take the gun out and lock my family in the shelter, and then took a front position in the kitchen,
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得对我来说最正确的第一件事就是把枪拿出来，把家人锁在避难室里，然后到厨房占据正面位置，

sentences.en: where I can have a better view of the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 在那里我可以更好地观察社区的情况。

sentences.en: And if someone comes, I can respond and engage before they come to my house.
sentences.zh: 如果有人来，我可以在他们来到我家之前做出反应并进行交火。

sentences.en: And next we started to hear shooting, and we started to hear talks in Arabic, and I was looking outside of the kitchen windows,
sentences.zh: 接下来我们开始听到枪声，开始听到有人说阿拉伯语，我朝厨房窗户外面看去，

sentences.en: and then I saw in the outside perimeter of my neighborhood, I saw some terrorists standing outside with RPGs and heavy machine guns.
sentences.zh: 然后我看到在我社区的外围，看到一些恐怖分子拿着RPG和重机枪站在外面。

sentences.en: What did you think?
sentences.zh: 你当时是怎么想的？

sentences.en: I knew it was bad, and then I saw them exiting an apartment of one of my friends.
sentences.zh: 我知道情况不妙，然后我看到他们从我一个朋友的公寓里走出来。

sentences.en: I saw three guys with a fighting vest, with all the equipment, the gear and the helmets, and behind them, three guys wearing civilian uniforms,
sentences.zh: 我看到三个人穿着战术背心，带着所有的装备、护具和头盔，在他们后面是三个穿着平民服装的人，

sentences.en: and they were exiting my neighbor's apartment.
sentences.zh: 他们正从我邻居的公寓里走出来。

sentences.en: And then, oh, it was horrible, I didn't know what to do, if he's alive, if he's dead, he's kidnapped, I didn't know, I just saw them exiting the apartment.
sentences.zh: 然后，哦，太可怕了，我不知道该怎么办，他活着还是死了，他被绑架了吗，我不知道，我只看到他们从公寓里走出来。

sentences.en: And then, and then there was units starting entering the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 然后，然后开始有小队进入社区。

sentences.en: I saw them going near one of the families and start shouting,
sentences.zh: 我看到他们走到其中一个家庭附近开始大喊，

sentences.en: Tzal, Tzal, like IDF, IDF, to make my neighbors think that they are from the IDF, and they will give up and get out.
sentences.zh: Tzal，Tzal，就像以色列国防军、以色列国防军那样，好让我的邻居以为他们是以色列国防军，然后他们就会放弃并走出来。

sentences.en: To make your neighbors think they were actually from the Israeli military, that's the IDF.
sentences.zh: 让你的邻居以为他们实际上是以色列军队，也就是以色列国防军。

sentences.en: Yeah, and this group were dressed like an Israeli police officer, but something about the way they were dressed.
sentences.zh: 是的，这群人穿得像以色列警察，但他们穿衣服的方式有点不对劲。

sentences.en: They were, I don't know how to describe it, a bit sloppy, sloppy.
sentences.zh: 他们，我不知道该怎么形容，有点马虎，马虎。

sentences.en: You know, it's not, it didn't felt right for me.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，这不对劲，感觉不对。

sentences.en: And I text my friend, I don't think it's the IDF, don't open the door.
sentences.zh: 我给我的朋友发短信说，我觉得这不是以色列国防军，不要开门。

sentences.en: And then I heard Arabic from real, real close, and I heard shooting from real close.
sentences.zh: 然后我听到非常非常近的阿拉伯语，我听到非常近的枪声。

sentences.en: And I saw from around the corner, terrorists, I saw them going towards my balcony.
sentences.zh: 我看到转角处有恐怖分子，我看到他们朝我的阳台走去。

sentences.en: I was standing at my post of the kitchen, and I just saw them coming from around the corner.
sentences.zh: 我正站在厨房的岗位上，我看到他们从街角转过来。

sentences.en: I saw their face.
sentences.zh: 我看到了他们的脸。

sentences.en: You could see murder in their eyes.
sentences.zh: 你能从他们的眼中看到杀戮。

sentences.en: I saw in their eyes, they are going to kill my family.
sentences.zh: 我在他们的眼中看到，他们要杀死我的家人。

sentences.en: I need to shoot now, or else it's going to be my family.
sentences.zh: 我必须现在开枪，否则遭殃的就是我的家人了。

sentences.en: It's now or never.
sentences.zh: 此时不搏更待何时。

sentences.en: So I started shooting.
sentences.zh: 所以我开始开枪。

sentences.en: I gave a burst of five or six bullets toward them, and they shot back at my home.
sentences.zh: 我朝他们连开五六枪，他们也向我的家开枪反击。

sentences.en: They shot with automatic weapons.
sentences.zh: 他们使用的是自动武器。

sentences.en: So then I'm shooting now from here, and I'm going to a different position to shoot from a different position.
sentences.zh: 所以现在我从这里开枪，然后我要去另一个位置从不同的位置开枪。

sentences.en: Because you don't fire twice from the same position.
sentences.zh: 因为你不能在同一个位置开枪两次。

sentences.en: So it seems like there are more than one armed person inside the house.
sentences.zh: 所以看起来屋里有不止一个持枪人员。

sentences.en: In Israel, you join the army in the age of 18, and then you do a reserve duty until you are about the age of 40.
sentences.zh: 在以色列，你18岁参军，然后服预备役直到40岁左右。

sentences.en: So you don't think.
sentences.zh: 所以你不会去想。

sentences.en: You act like a warrior.
sentences.zh: 你像个战士一样行动。

sentences.en: You switch to a different mood, and it's like a muscle memory.
sentences.zh: 你切换到另一种情绪状态，这就像是肌肉记忆。

sentences.en: And it's like a slow motion movie.
sentences.zh: 这就好像是一部慢动作电影。

sentences.en: Everything is slow.
sentences.zh: 一切都是慢的。

sentences.en: Everything is...
sentences.zh: 一切都……

sentences.en: You see every move, like, flow.
sentences.zh: 你看到每一个动作，就像是在流淌。

sentences.en: And then you hear them shooting back, and then you...
sentences.zh: 然后你听到他们开枪反击，然后你……

sentences.en: It's like a fast forward.
sentences.zh: 这就像是快进。

sentences.en: You jump to the floor and hide from the bullets.
sentences.zh: 你扑倒在地板上躲避子弹。

sentences.en: So the time moves slowly and is suspended, and then the time moves very quickly and speeds up.
sentences.zh: 所以时间移动得很慢并且停滞了，然后时间移动得非常快并加速了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: It's like a weird dream or something.
sentences.zh: 这就像是一个奇怪的梦什么的。

sentences.en: Yeah, like a weird dream.
sentences.zh: 是的，就像一个奇怪的梦。

sentences.en: Do you remember feeling fear?
sentences.zh: 你还记得感到恐惧吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, of course.
sentences.zh: 对，当然。

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: If you don't feel fear, you're an idiot.
sentences.zh: 如果你不感到恐惧，你就是个白痴。

sentences.en: I felt fear, and I felt fear for my family and my neighbors.
sentences.zh: 我感到恐惧，我为我的家人和邻居感到恐惧。

sentences.en: But the fear is set aside, and now it's time to engage the enemy.
sentences.zh: 但恐惧被抛在一边，现在是与敌人交战的时候了。

sentences.en: So then, after several bursts of fire toward the balcony and toward the rest of the house, they shot the house from many positions.
sentences.zh: 然后，在向阳台和房子其他地方进行了几轮射击后，他们从多个位置向房子开枪。

sentences.en: But my family were in the safe room, and the safe room can stand the heat of a missile.
sentences.zh: 但我的家人在避难室里，避难室能经受住导弹的高温。

sentences.en: So I wasn't worried about them.
sentences.zh: 所以我并不担心他们。

sentences.en: It's okay, shoot the house as much as you like.
sentences.zh: 没关系，随便你们怎么轰炸这房子。

sentences.en: I'm on the floor.
sentences.zh: 我趴在地板上。

sentences.en: It's okay now.
sentences.zh: 现在没事了。

sentences.en: And then, I don't know why, they left.
sentences.zh: 然后，我不知道为什么，他们离开了。

sentences.en: They decided to go.
sentences.zh: 他们决定走了。

sentences.en: They went to a different house.
sentences.zh: 他们去了另一所房子。

sentences.en: Then it got quiet.
sentences.zh: 然后四周静了下来。

sentences.en: It got quiet.
sentences.zh: 静下来了。

sentences.en: When I say quiet, I mean, I didn't see any attackers, any terrorists outside.
sentences.zh: 当我安静时，我的意思是，我在外面看不到任何袭击者，任何恐怖分子。

sentences.en: You could always hear all the time the noise of the weapons shooting outside.
sentences.zh: 你总是能听到外面武器射击的声音。

sentences.en: I can hear them throwing grenades, but I didn't see for like an hour anyone else.
sentences.zh: 我能听到他们扔手榴弹，但我有一个多小时没看到其他人。

sentences.en: And then, I heard one of my neighbors texting in the group of the neighborhood that they're in his house, and they're trying to break into the safe room.
sentences.zh: 然后，我听到我的一位邻居在社区群里发短信说他们在他的房子里，他们正试图闯入避难室。

sentences.en: But he was holding on to the lever, so they won't be able to open the door.
sentences.zh: 但他一直死死抓着把手，这样他们就无法打开门。

sentences.en: And then, I guess they got tired of trying to, and they just set the house on fire.
sentences.zh: 然后，我猜他们试烦了，于是直接把房子点着了。

sentences.en: And at first, I didn't saw the fire.
sentences.zh: 起初我没有看到火。

sentences.en: Then, I heard a weird noise, a weird, unfamiliar noise of cracking stuff.
sentences.zh: 然后，我听到一种奇怪的声音，一种奇怪的、不熟悉的碎裂声。

sentences.en: It seems like stuff is cracking, cracking wood.
sentences.zh: 看起来有什么东西在碎裂，木头发出的碎裂声。

sentences.en: And I looked outside, and I saw all the top floor on fire.
sentences.zh: 我往外一看，看到整个顶楼都在着火。

sentences.en: And they started texting that the fire, the smoke is getting inside the safe room.
sentences.zh: 他们开始发短信说火、烟正钻进避难室。

sentences.en: And in the kibbutz text group, they said, you need to put wet fabric on your mouth to chill you from the smoke, but the house is on fire.
sentences.zh: 在基布兹的文本群里，他们说，你们得把湿布捂在嘴上以免被烟熏倒，但房子着火了。

sentences.en: And in a certain time, it wasn't safe for them anymore.
sentences.zh: 在某个时刻，对他们来说那里已经不再安全了。

sentences.en: And I told them, I don't see anyone outside from my position.
sentences.zh: 我对他们说，从我的位置我看不到外面有任何人。

sentences.en: So, they jumped to the ground level, the family with the two kids, and ran straight to the neighbor's house, and got inside to his safe room, together with him.
sentences.zh: 于是，这一家四口跳到地面上，直接跑到邻居家里，和邻居一起进了他的避难室。

sentences.en: So, the whole village was giving them instruction by text?
sentences.zh: 所以整个村庄都在通过短信发布指令？

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: The whole village was giving each other instruction.
sentences.zh: 整个村庄都在互相发布指令。

sentences.en: We were all under attack.
sentences.zh: 我们都遭到了袭击。

sentences.en: Not only our neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 不仅是我们的社区。

sentences.en: There were some neighborhoods closer to the eastern side, the side of Gaza,
sentences.zh: 有些社区更靠近东边，也就是加沙那一侧，

sentences.en: that were heavily attacked, much heavier attacks than we got.
sentences.zh: 遭受了猛烈的袭击，比我们遭遇的袭击要沉重得多。

sentences.en: They got RPGs on their house, on the safe rooMs.
sentences.zh: 他们的房子、他们的避难室遭到了RPG袭击。

sentences.en: And then, in the text group, a daughter of one of my best friends just sent a recording of her.
sentences.zh: 然后，在短信群里，我最好的朋友之一的女儿发了一条她的录音。

sentences.en: She wasn't shouting, she was whispering, help us, my mother and brother are dying.
sentences.zh: 她没有大喊大叫，她一直在低语，救救我们，我妈妈和哥哥快不行了。

sentences.en: My father is hurt and he's dying.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸受伤了，他快死了。

sentences.en: They're trying to enter the house and he's on fire.
sentences.zh: 他们正试图闯进屋里，而且他身上着火了。

sentences.en: And she just kept on sending this kind of message.
sentences.zh: 而她就一直不断发这种信息。

sentences.en: And I know this girl.
sentences.zh: 而且我认识这个女孩。

sentences.en: And I know she's a good friend of my girl's.
sentences.zh: 我知道她是我女儿的好朋友。

sentences.en: And she'd been to our house several times.
sentences.zh: 她去过我们家好几次。

sentences.en: And I used to work with her father.
sentences.zh: 我以前和她父亲一起工作过。

sentences.en: And we are one family.
sentences.zh: 我们是一家人。

sentences.en: We are like one family.
sentences.zh: 我们就像一家人一样。

sentences.en: And I hear her recording.
sentences.zh: 我听到了她的录音。

sentences.en: Just help us.
sentences.zh: 救救我们就行。

sentences.en: Help us.
sentences.zh: 救救我们。

sentences.en: My father is dying.
sentences.zh: 我爸爸快死了。

sentences.en: My mother is already dead.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈已经去世了。

sentences.en: My older brother is lying dead.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥躺在那儿，已经死了。

sentences.en: And you feel helpless.
sentences.zh: 而你会感到无能为力。

sentences.en: How old is she?
sentences.zh: 她多大了？

sentences.en: I think about 10 years old.
sentences.zh: 我想大概10岁吧。

sentences.en: She had to see her parents critically injured in front of her eyes.
sentences.zh: 她不得不亲眼看到父母受到重伤。

sentences.en: And just, she couldn't do anything.
sentences.zh: 然后就是，她什么也做不了。

sentences.en: And I couldn't do anything.
sentences.zh: 我也什么都做不了。

sentences.en: And no one could do anything.
sentences.zh: 谁也什么都做不了。

sentences.en: Later on, I heard they managed to rescue both of them.
sentences.zh: 后来，我听说他们设法把他们两个都救出来了。

sentences.en: After shooting with a tank because there were terrorists inside their home.
sentences.zh: 在用坦克开火之后，因为他们家里有恐怖分子。

sentences.en: And they, they survived.
sentences.zh: 然后他们，他们活下来了。

sentences.en: The girl is okay.
sentences.zh: 这女孩没事。

sentences.en: And their father is, just got out of surgery.
sentences.zh: 他们的父亲，刚做完手术。

sentences.en: He lost his leg.
sentences.zh: 他失去了一条腿。

sentences.en: But he's alive.
sentences.zh: 但他还活着。

sentences.en: He's with us.
sentences.zh: 他和我们在一起。

sentences.en: Not like a lot of my friends.
sentences.zh: 不像我的很多朋友。

sentences.en: But the rest of her family was killed.
sentences.zh: 但她家里的其他人遇害了。

sentences.en: The rest of her family was killed.
sentences.zh: 她家里的其他人遇害了。

sentences.en: Golan, when did you finally leave the house?
sentences.zh: 戈兰，你最后是什么时候离开房子的？

sentences.en: And when did the police finally respond?
sentences.zh: 警方是什么时候做出回应的？

sentences.en: We heard a big noise.
sentences.zh: 我们听到一声巨响。

sentences.en: Really weird one.
sentences.zh: 非常奇怪的声音。

sentences.en: And I opened the window to get a different view.
sentences.zh: 我打开窗户想看看外面的情况。

sentences.en: And I saw tanks.
sentences.zh: 我看到了坦克。

sentences.en: Tanks on the neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 社区里有坦克。

sentences.en: It's not something, it's not something you're supposed to see.
sentences.zh: 这不是那种，这不是你应该看到的景象。

sentences.en: So I knew things are going to change, but I don't know how long it's going to take.
sentences.zh: 所以我知道情况要变了，但我不知道这需要多久。

sentences.en: And then a unit of the army came and took us out.
sentences.zh: 然后一队军队来了，把我们带了出去。

sentences.en: It was nighttime, but we could see a lot.
sentences.zh: 那是晚上，但我们能看得很清楚。

sentences.en: To see the kibbutz burned to the ground.
sentences.zh: 看到基布兹被烧成了平地。

sentences.en: It was horrible.
sentences.zh: 太可怕了。

sentences.en: We could see the house of my neighbors.
sentences.zh: 我们能看到邻居的房子。

sentences.en: Normally, when you have a fire in the house, the firefighters are coming.
sentences.zh: 通常，如果家里发生火灾，消防员会赶来。

sentences.en: And they put out the fire.
sentences.zh: 然后把火扑灭。

sentences.en: But here I could see the fire dies out after burning everything.
sentences.zh: 但在这里，我眼看着大火烧毁一切后自己熄灭了。

sentences.en: We were encircled by the soldiers who kept us safe and took us.
sentences.zh: 我们被士兵包围了，他们保护着我们并将我们带走。

sentences.en: And they told us to close the eyes of the young kids.
sentences.zh: 他们告诉我们要闭上小孩子的眼睛。

sentences.en: So they won't see the dead bodies of the terrorists lying outside.
sentences.zh: 这样他们就不会看到外面躺着的恐怖分子的尸体。

sentences.en: So they won't have to have this kind of memories in their mind.
sentences.zh: 这样他们的脑海里就不会留下这种记忆。

sentences.en: They won't be scarred more than they are already scarred.
sentences.zh: 他们不会受到比现在更深的创伤。

sentences.en: And we went to the entrance of the kibbutz.
sentences.zh: 我们来到了基布兹的入口。

sentences.en: And they took us to the evacuation area.
sentences.zh: 他们把我们带到了疏散区。

sentences.en: And we were just about to go on a truck, an army truck, to evacuate us.
sentences.zh: 我们正要上一辆卡车，一辆运送我们撤离的军用卡车。

sentences.en: And then from the bushes, one of the terrorists just started shooting at us with no cover.
sentences.zh: 然后从灌木丛里，其中一个恐怖分子毫无掩护地开始向我们开枪。

sentences.en: And we had to lie on my kids and protect them, my twins.
sentences.zh: 我们不得不趴在我的孩子们身上保护他们，我的双胞胎。

sentences.en: I had to shelter them with my body and shout to my kids.
sentences.zh: 我必须用身体护住他们，并向我的孩子们大喊。

sentences.en: I lost my two grown-up kids.
sentences.zh: 我失去了两个已经成年的孩子。

sentences.en: I shout to them, where are you?
sentences.zh: 我向他们大喊，你们在哪儿？

sentences.en: Where are you?
sentences.zh: 你们在哪儿？

sentences.en: And it seems like forever, but they killed the terrorists very quickly, the soldiers.
sentences.zh: 感觉好像过了很久很久，但士兵们非常快地击毙了恐怖分子。

sentences.en: And no one was injured.
sentences.zh: 没有人受伤。

sentences.en: What time was that approximately?
sentences.zh: 那大约是什么时间？

sentences.en: Do you have any sense of that?
sentences.zh: 你有什么概念吗？

sentences.en: That was 10 o'clock at night, 10.30, when we left the perimeter.
sentences.zh: 那是晚上10点，10点半，当我们离开外围的时候。

sentences.en: And it began at 6 in the morning.
sentences.zh: 而这一切始于清晨6点。

sentences.en: That is so many hours.
sentences.zh: 那是好多个小时。

sentences.en: That's eternity.
sentences.zh: 简直像个世纪那么长。

sentences.en: It's, I just can't describe the feeling.
sentences.zh: 这，我简直无法形容这种感觉。

sentences.en: It just felt like an eternity.
sentences.zh: 感觉就像度日如年。

sentences.en: And later on, we were evacuated to the hotel in the Dead Sea, where we are now.
sentences.zh: 后来，我们被疏散到死海的一家酒店，也就是我们现在待的地方。

sentences.en: Did anybody in your neighborhood die?
sentences.zh: 你邻居里有人遇难吗？

sentences.en: We don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道。

sentences.en: We don't know.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道。

sentences.en: We have, we get drips by drips of names.
sentences.zh: 我们，我们一点一点地得到名字。

sentences.en: And today, all the grown-ups in the community got inside the conference room of the hotel.
sentences.zh: 今天，社区里所有的大人都聚集在酒店的会议室里。

sentences.en: And they were sitting there, some members of the community with the liSt.
sentences.zh: 他们坐在那里，一些社区成员手里拿着名单。

sentences.en: And they were starting to read the names of the people we know are dead.
sentences.zh: 他们开始宣读我们知道已经遇难的人的名字。

sentences.en: And each one of the members got the page and start reading like 10 names and then collapse back.
sentences.zh: 社区成员每人拿一页纸，开始读大约10个名字，然后就崩溃了。

sentences.en: And then the other one next to him stand and start reading some more names.
sentences.zh: 然后他旁边的人站起来，开始读更多的名字。

sentences.en: And sit back and sit back and like, I don't know how many.
sentences.zh: 然后坐回去，坐回去，就像，我不知道有多少人。

sentences.en: I don't know how many.
sentences.zh: 我不知道有多少人。

sentences.en: I couldn't count.
sentences.zh: 我数不清。

sentences.en: And then I know each one of them.
sentences.zh: 然后我认识他们每一个人。

sentences.en: I know each one of them.
sentences.zh: 我认识他们每一个人。

sentences.en: And they read the names.
sentences.zh: 他们宣读着名字。

sentences.en: And they paused and said, now we are going to read the names of the people we don't know where they are.
sentences.zh: 然后他们停顿了一下说，现在我们要宣读那些我们不知道他们在哪里的失踪人员的名字。

sentences.en: And it was just as long.
sentences.zh: 而且名单同样很长。

sentences.en: A good friend of mine, she was, they broke into her safe room.
sentences.zh: 我的一个好朋友，她，他们强行闯入了她的安全室。

sentences.en: They pulled her out, she and their kids.
sentences.zh: 他们把她和她的孩子拉了出来。

sentences.en: And they told them to sit outside.
sentences.zh: 他们让他们坐在外面。

sentences.en: And they took all the men and the boys from this group, put them on a truck, and just went to Gaza.
sentences.zh: 他们把这群人里所有的男人和男孩都带走，塞进一辆卡车，直接拉去了加沙。

sentences.en: And they took her son.
sentences.zh: 他们带走了她的儿子。

sentences.en: He's the best friend of my son.
sentences.zh: 他是我儿子的最好朋友。

sentences.en: And he's 16 years old and he's the most adorable, gentle kid.
sentences.zh: 他16岁，是个最招人喜爱、温和的孩子。

sentences.en: And they just ripped him away from the hands of his mother.
sentences.zh: 他们就这样把他从他母亲手中硬生生地夺走了。

sentences.en: My son is devastated.
sentences.zh: 我儿子崩溃了。

sentences.en: And we are all devastated.
sentences.zh: 我们全都很崩溃。

sentences.en: And we don't know what happened to our family.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道我们的家人发生了什么。

sentences.en: We don't know what happened to our friends.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道我们的朋友发生了什么。

sentences.en: We know that they killed one out of ten of our community.
sentences.zh: 我们知道我们社区十分之一的人被杀害了。

sentences.en: One out of ten is dead.
sentences.zh: 十分之一的人遇难了。

sentences.en: But a lot more were taken.
sentences.zh: 但还有更多的人被抓走了。

sentences.en: They took babies.
sentences.zh: 他们带走了婴儿。

sentences.en: They took kids.
sentences.zh: 他们带走了孩子。

sentences.en: They took elderly people.
sentences.zh: 他们带走了老人。

sentences.en: 80 years old woman.
sentences.zh: 80岁的老妇人。

sentences.en: She was like my grandmother.
sentences.zh: 她就像我的祖母一样。

sentences.en: I know her from the day I was born.
sentences.zh: 我从出生起就认识她。

sentences.en: She was like my grandmother.
sentences.zh: 她就像我的祖母一样。

sentences.en: And we were laughing together like two weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 就在两周前我们还在一起有说有笑。

sentences.en: And now they took her.
sentences.zh: 而现在他们把她抓走了。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: What kind of...
sentences.zh: 这算什么……

sentences.en: They are not human beings.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不是人。

sentences.en: They are not human beings.
sentences.zh: 他们根本不是人。

sentences.en: A human being couldn't do this kind of...
sentences.zh: 是人就做不出这种……

sentences.en: They are vicious killers.
sentences.zh: 他们是残暴的杀人犯。

sentences.en: They are not freedom fighters.
sentences.zh: 他们不是什么自由战士。

sentences.en: They are not fighting to liberate their country.
sentences.zh: 他们不是在为解放国家而战。

sentences.en: And our community donated every year money to some people who used to work in the kibbutz.
sentences.zh: 而我们社区每年都会向一些曾在基布兹工作过的人捐款。

sentences.en: These are people from Gaza.
sentences.zh: 这些人来自加沙。

sentences.en: People from Gaza.
sentences.zh: 来自加沙的人。

sentences.en: They were our friends.
sentences.zh: 他们曾是我们的朋友。

sentences.en: And we donated money to them.
sentences.zh: 我们还向他们捐过钱。

sentences.en: The mother of a friend of mine was kidnapped.
sentences.zh: 我一个朋友的母亲被绑架了。

sentences.en: She used to go once a week to one of the border crossing with Gaza Strip and pick up with her car children and take them to get dialysis in Israeli hospitals.
sentences.zh: 她过去常常每周去一次加沙地带的一个边境检查站，用自己的车接送孩子们去以色列的医院做透析。

sentences.en: And now she's in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 而现在她在加沙。

sentences.en: We are a liberal person.
sentences.zh: 我们是很开明的人。

sentences.en: We don't believe that all of the people in Gaza are evil.
sentences.zh: 我们不认为加沙的所有人都是恶魔。

sentences.en: We don't believe.
sentences.zh: 我们不这样认为。

sentences.en: We didn't believe.
sentences.zh: 我们以前不这样认为。

sentences.en: I'm sorry.
sentences.zh: 对不起。

sentences.en: We didn't believe.
sentences.zh: 我们以前不这样认为。

sentences.en: I don't know what I'm thinking now.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我现在在想什么。

sentences.en: I don't know what to think now.
sentences.zh: 我不知道现在该作何感想。

sentences.en: Because we always thought that peace and negotiation is the solution.
sentences.zh: 因为我们一直认为和平与谈判才是出路。

sentences.en: And I don't think anyone thinks now we lost our fate.
sentences.zh: 我不认为现在还有人这么想，我们的信念已经破灭了。

sentences.en: We don't think there could be any kind of reason to talk with these animals that destroyed my kibbutz, kidnapped my family.
sentences.zh: 我们不认为还有任何理由去跟这些毁灭了我的基布兹、绑架了我的家人的野兽对话。

sentences.en: And we want them back.
sentences.zh: 我们要他们回来。

sentences.en: We can't be a community without them.
sentences.zh: 没有他们，我们就不算一个完整的社区。

sentences.en: They are part of us.
sentences.zh: 他们是我们的一部分。

sentences.en: It's like a jigsaw puzzle.
sentences.zh: 就像拼图一样。

sentences.en: You can't take one piece and it will be okay.
sentences.zh: 你不能抽走其中一块，还能指望一切安好。

sentences.en: The ones that are dead are gone.
sentences.zh: 死去的人已经回不来了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: But we need them.
sentences.zh: 但我们需要他们。

sentences.en: We need the ones that survived.
sentences.zh: 我们需要那些幸存下来的人。

sentences.en: Get my neighbors back.
sentences.zh: 把我的邻居们带回来。

sentences.en: I want them back.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们回来。

sentences.en: They are my friends.
sentences.zh: 他们是我的朋友。

sentences.en: They are my family.
sentences.zh: 他们是我的家人。

sentences.en: I want them back.
sentences.zh: 我希望他们回来。

sentences.en: And I go in the hotel and it's like a roller coaster of emotions.
sentences.zh: 当我走进酒店时，那种情绪就像过山车一样起伏。

sentences.en: Because I hear someone just died and it breaks my heart and I collapse.
sentences.zh: 因为我听到有人刚刚去世，这让我心碎，我几近崩溃。

sentences.en: And a second later I see someone arriving that I was sure that he was dead and I was afraid to ask.
sentences.zh: 但紧接着一秒钟，我看到一个我确信已经死了、甚至不敢去询问的人到达了。

sentences.en: And then another one is dead and another one alive.
sentences.zh: 然后又有一个人死了，另一个人还活着。

sentences.en: And it's a roller coaster of emotions.
sentences.zh: 这真是一种情绪的过山车。

sentences.en: What are the children like in the hotel?
sentences.zh: 酒店里的孩子们怎么样？

sentences.en: How are your nine-year-old daughters?
sentences.zh: 你那九岁的女儿们怎么样？

sentences.en: My twins are playing.
sentences.zh: 我的双胞胎在玩耍。

sentences.en: They talked to a psychiatrist and they didn't saw anything.
sentences.zh: 她们跟心理医生谈过，她们什么也没看到。

sentences.en: They heard the noise of the shooting, but they didn't saw the terrorists.
sentences.zh: 她们听到了枪声，但没有看到恐怖分子。

sentences.en: They didn't saw the bodies.
sentences.zh: 她们没有看到尸体。

sentences.en: My older kids saw the bodies.
sentences.zh: 我较大的孩子看到了尸体。

sentences.en: They know about their friends that were kidnapped and they know about their friends that were slaughtered.
sentences.zh: 他们知道自己的朋友被绑架了，也知道朋友被屠杀了。

sentences.en: They know.
sentences.zh: 他们知道。

sentences.en: And there will never be kids again.
sentences.zh: 而且他们再也无法像真正的孩子那样生活了。

sentences.en: Their childhood is over.
sentences.zh: 他们的童年结束了。

sentences.en: And I know my son will never be the same again.
sentences.zh: 我知道我的儿子再也回不到从前了。

sentences.en: His childhood is over.
sentences.zh: 他的童年结束了。

sentences.en: His friends are dead or gone in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 他的朋友们有的死了，有的去了加沙。

sentences.en: And now we need to start to rebuild our life from scratch.
sentences.zh: 现在我们需要从零开始重建我们的生活。

sentences.en: And from the moment we arrived here, we rebuild infrastructure of the community.
sentences.zh: 从我们到达这里的那一刻起，我们就重建了社区的基础设施。

sentences.en: There is a person who is in charge of finding people a place to sleep in.
sentences.zh: 有一个人负责为人们找地方睡觉。

sentences.en: Someone who is in charge of activities for the kids.
sentences.zh: 有人负责孩子们的活动。

sentences.en: And we have a person who is in charge of the elderly persons.
sentences.zh: 我们还有一个人专门负责照顾老人。

sentences.en: And the nurse of the kibbutz is in charge of getting people their medicines that they left back at home.
sentences.zh: 基布兹的护士负责帮大家取回留在家里的药。

sentences.en: We rebuild our community here in the hotel so we could survive the day to come because we don't know how long we are going to be here.
sentences.zh: 我们在酒店里重建了我们的社区，这样我们才能度过接下来的每一天，因为我们不知道还要在这里待多久。

sentences.en: We don't know if we have a place to go back to.
sentences.zh: 我们不知道自己是否还有家可回。

sentences.en: And I don't know if my home is still standing.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我的房子是否还完好无损。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: Do you feel that it changed you?
sentences.zh: 你觉得这改变了你吗？

sentences.en: I'm sure it did.
sentences.zh: 我确信改变了。

sentences.en: I always say I was scratched already before with all the military service I've been through.
sentences.zh: 我常说，经历过所有的兵役之后，我身上其实早就有了划痕。

sentences.en: But this is a different kind of scratch.
sentences.zh: 但这是一种不同的划痕。

sentences.en: So many friends of mine died.
sentences.zh: 我的好多朋友都死了。

sentences.en: So many.
sentences.zh: 好多好多次。

sentences.en: When half of your friend died, there is no coming back.
sentences.zh: 当一半的朋友都离去时，一切就再也回不去了。

sentences.en: I'm not going to be the same person as before.
sentences.zh: 我不会再是以前那个我了。

sentences.en: I'm trying to keep my humor as much as I can.
sentences.zh: 我尽量保持幽默感。

sentences.en: But none of us are going to be the same again.

sentences.en: Instead, they threw their weight behind his challenger, Representative Jim Jordan of Ohio, the right-wing Republican endorsed by former President Donald Trump.
